# ChartNexus

> Experimental Apache ECharts infrastructure for model-generated chart documents. The host decides when to invoke a chart and is responsible for data truth and authorization. ChartNexus validates and renders supported input faithfully; it does not execute model code or invent facts.

## Start here

- [Agent integration and retrieval](docs/en/agent-guide.md): discovery order, host policy, MCP resources, 0.3 recipe URIs and prompt template.
- [Product responsibility boundary](docs/en/product-boundary.md): ownership, safety and production limitations.
- [Chart catalog](docs/en/chart-catalog.md): all eleven 0.3 types and example links.
- [Developer quick start](docs/en/getting-started.md): runnable browser example and integration steps.
- [GenUI integrations](docs/en/genui-integrations.md): pinned OpenUI, A2UI and COSUI profiles.
- [Chinese index](llms.zh-CN.txt).

## Contracts and resources

- [0.3 schema](packages/schema/src/chart-document-0.3.schema.json): experimental intent, eleven type-specific branches.
- [0.3 capabilities](packages/core/src/capabilities-0.3.json): actual options and limits; maps require host-owned assets.
- [Recipe manifest](resources/recipes/manifest.json): synthetic examples, versions, negative cases and MCP URIs.
- [Model resource index](resources/model-index.json) and [retrieval JSONL](resources/model-retrieval.jsonl): language, capability IDs, sources, license, hashes and full bodies.
- [Synthetic 0.3 input/output examples](resources/model-examples.jsonl): 11 types × two languages; explicit inputs, source hashes and host prerequisites. MCP: `chartnexus://resources/examples/0.1`.
- MCP stdio resources: `chartnexus://resources/index/0.1`, `chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1`, `chartnexus://schema/chart-document/0.3` and `chartnexus://recipes/manifest/0.1`. Inspect host permissions and explicitly select the schema version; `get_chart_schema` defaults to 0.1.

Packages are private and unpublished. Examples are synthetic, not factual answers. Hosting this file at a website URL requires separate deployment; file presence does not guarantee any model will discover or learn it.

# Product boundary and ownership

[简体中文](../zh-CN/product-boundary.md)

ChartNexus provides versioned chart documents, validation/compilation, browser and SVG rendering, pinned GenUI adapter profiles, and model-facing resources. The host supplies complete data or authorized data references. Input flows through an optional protocol adapter → ChartDocument → validation/compilation → renderer → host component. Use a renderer directly without MCP or a model service.

| Responsibility | ChartNexus | Host / data / model |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Choosing whether to show a chart or invoke a component | Describe supported capabilities and input | Select and invoke the component |
| Truth, provenance and authorization of business data | Validate supported structure and references; do not infer facts | Retrieve, authorize and verify data |
| Rendering supplied values | Preserve values, units, nulls, identity and declared transformations; report unsupported input | Choose explicit operations and provide an appropriate container |
| Broken, incomplete or stale output | Return diagnostics; retain a prior chart where the selected runtime/adapter guarantees it | Assemble complete messages, manage retries, ordering and fallbacks |
| Themes and information density | Bounded light/dark, transparent background and five detail levels in the opt-in chat profile | Set host policy and ensure readable surrounding surfaces |
| Model interoperability | Publish schema, capabilities, examples and diagnostics; test usability | Select/configure models, prompt and tools; no guaranteed invocation or accuracy |

We do not fetch facts, silently repair business data, execute model code, provide arbitrary ECharts options, or guarantee every protocol/model. The guarded native profile has partial validation. Schema validation is not a truth check, security certification, or a guarantee of good chart choice. Existing model evaluations are diagnostic evidence of one setup, not a universal product acceptance threshold. A model failure to choose a component or generate factual data is not a ChartNexus rendering failure.

Before production, verify the exact host/SDK/browser, stream assembly, error handling, resource limits, delivery/versioning and operational policy. Server rendering and remote services need host-specific isolation and access control; local stdio MCP is not a public server. See [support matrix](support-matrix.md) and [getting started](getting-started.md).

# Chart and capability catalog

[简体中文](../zh-CN/chart-catalog.md)

The experimental 0.3 intent profile supports eleven bounded chart types. These synthetic examples demonstrate contracts, not factual answers. Every link below is a complete 0.3 recipe. Earlier 0.1/0.2 recipes remain available in the manifest. Use the 0.3 schema projection for the selected type.

| Type | Input shape / principal limit | Runnable recipe |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bar | categorical x, numeric y; horizontal variant supported | [0.3 bar](../../resources/recipes/chat-bar-03.json) |
| line | categorical or explicit temporal x; numeric y; optional area | [0.3 line](../../resources/recipes/line-03.json) |
| pie | categories and nonnegative numbers; zero shares are not invented | [0.3 pie](../../resources/recipes/pie-03.json) |
| scatter | numeric x and y | [0.3 scatter](../../resources/recipes/scatter-03.json) |
| combo | one bar and one line; axis/unit rules apply | [0.3 combo](../../resources/recipes/combo-03.json) |
| funnel | categories and nonnegative values; no inferred conversion | [0.3 funnel](../../resources/recipes/funnel-03.json) |
| heatmap | categorical x/y and numeric value; explicit min/max; no duplicate cells | [0.3 heatmap](../../resources/recipes/heatmap-03.json) |
| radar | explicit indicators and ranges | [0.3 radar](../../resources/recipes/radar-03.json) |
| tree | unique node IDs, parent references and one acyclic root | [0.3 tree](../../resources/recipes/tree-03.json) |
| sankey | graph with nodes and nonnegative acyclic links | [0.3 sankey](../../resources/recipes/sankey-03.json) |
| map | region table, explicit color domain, trusted host map asset and revision | [0.3 map](../../resources/recipes/map-03.json) |

Presentation is host-controlled through the opt-in chat profile: light/dark, transparent or host-selected background, and minimal/simple/standard/detailed/comprehensive. Refer to [contract](contracts-03.md), [presentation](chat-presentation.md), and [support matrix](support-matrix.md) for exact rules and tested versions.

Run `pnpm dev` and open `/chat.html` for presentation, `/expansion.html` for radar/tree/sankey/map, `/openui.html`, `/a2ui.html`, `/cosui.html` and `/marklang.html` for host integrations. # Agent integration and retrieval guide

[简体中文](../zh-CN/agent-guide.md)

The application decides whether to request a chart and supplies authorized data; ChartNexus does not discover facts or force tool calls. Give an agent the host's actual enabled profile, trusted data/field names and appropriate schema. Ask it for one complete JSON document. Never treat the synthetic examples below as answers to the user's business question.

Repository-aware tools can start from the plain-text [llms.txt](../../llms.txt) or [Chinese index](../../llms.zh-CN.txt); website hosting and automatic discovery are not implied. Both are included in the retrieval corpus.

## Discovery order

1. Inspect host policy: allowed versions/types, whether chat presentation or ordered operations are enabled, authorized table/map references, and size limits.
2. Read `chartnexus://capabilities/basic-0.3`, then call `get_chart_schema` with `{ "schemaVersion": "0.3", "chartType": "bar" }` (choose the requested supported type). Tool default is 0.1; a projected schema describes one branch, not host permissions.
3. Read `chartnexus://recipes/manifest/0.1` and the matching recipe URI. All eleven chart types have 0.3 recipes; older 0.2 recipes must retain their version unless explicitly migrated. Map requires a host-registered asset; references require authorized host registry and exact revisions.
4. Submit the complete document to `validate_chart`. Inspect actual `code` and JSON Pointer `path` on failure; retry only when host policy permits, without inventing business data. `compile_chart` provides a plan; `render_chart` produces a session-local SVG resource, not an interactive browser component.

## 0.3 recipe lookup

The recipe suffixes below are appended to `chartnexus://recipes/`: bar → `chat-bar/0.3`; line → `line/0.3`; pie → `pie/0.3`; scatter → `scatter/0.3`; combo → `combo/0.3`; funnel → `funnel/0.3`; heatmap → `heatmap/0.3`; radar → `radar/0.3`; tree → `tree/0.3`; sankey → `sankey/0.3`; map → `map/0.3`. The map recipe needs the host's `two-regions@1` synthetic asset; it cannot register that asset itself. Check the manifest and capabilities for constraints before reusing a recipe.

## Copyable prompt template

```text
The host has requested a chart. Output one complete ChartDocument JSON object.
Use only the supplied allowed schema/version, fields, values and authorized references.
Do not invent data or include executable functions, callbacks or URLs in the document. Apply aggregation or sorting only when explicitly requested.
Preserve nulls, units and source identity. Return a structured inability to comply through the host's own response format if necessary.
Host profile: <host-provided profile>; Schema: <schema or schema reference>;
Allowed data: <host-provided fields and rows or trusted reference>; User request: <request>.
```

The host chooses its own response envelope and handles refusal/no-chart states; those are not ChartDocument fields. For OpenUI/A2UI/COSUI, follow the relevant [GenUI guide](genui-integrations.md) and use the expected JSON string/operation envelope. For streaming, buffer fragments; pass only complete documents. The optional ordered profile needs a host-supplied operation ID and actual base revision. Do not invent them.

## Retrieval and training use

`chartnexus://resources/index/0.1` lists sources, versions, language, license and source-byte hashes. `chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1` provides newline-delimited records with `body`; filter by `language` and `capabilityIds`, then apply host profile policy and retrieve the relevant schema, catalog and example. `schemaVersion` gives the resource’s main version context; an entry can list additional compatible capability IDs. Index entries with `uri: null` are available in the retrieval corpus, not as independent MCP resources. Repository consumers can read [JSONL](../../resources/model-retrieval.jsonl) directly. Source examples are synthetic and Apache-2.0; preserve provenance/license and avoid training or indexing private data or held-out evaluation outputs. Reusing material does not mean a model has been trained or that an MCP client has selected it.

The separate [synthetic example pairs](../../resources/model-examples.jsonl) are also available from `chartnexus://resources/examples/0.1`: 11 chart types × two languages. Each record includes an explicit input data/chart specification, a complete output document, source recipe hash, license and any host prerequisite. They demonstrate serialization and faithful handling of supplied input; they do not teach or evaluate independent chart selection or factual retrieval. The corpus-level index language is `mul`; include it in language filters and then select individual `en` or `zh-CN` records. These 22 pairs are a small starting set, not evidence of training effectiveness or broad coverage. Review provenance and suitability before using them for training or few-shot prompts.

From the repository root, inspect the Chinese 0.3 guide records without an MCP client:

```js
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const records = readFileSync('resources/model-retrieval.jsonl', 'utf8')
  .trim().split('\n').map((line) => JSON.parse(line));
const guides = records.filter((item) => item.language === 'zh-CN'
  && item.capabilityIds.includes('basic-0.3')
  && ['agent-guide', 'chart-catalog'].includes(item.id));
console.log(guides.map(({ id, source, contentHash }) => ({ id, source, contentHash })));
```

Save this as an `.mjs` file and run it with Node from the repository root. A retrieval system should index `body`, retain the accompanying metadata and select only resources permitted by the host profile.

See [model entry](model-entry.md), [chart catalog](chart-catalog.md), [responsibility boundary](product-boundary.md), and [CLI/MCP guide](agent-integration.md).

--- doc_id: getting-started version: "0.1" status: experimental updated: 2026-11-01 language: en --- # Quick start: embed a chart in a chatbot [简体中文](../zh-CN/getting-started.md) This tutorial runs a real browser component from this repository without model credentials, Ollama or MCP. Version 0.3 is experimental; packages are private workspaces and are not available from public npm. ## 1. Prepare and run Install Node 22.22.3 (or tested 24.22.1), pnpm 11.25.0 and Git. In a terminal: ```sh git clone https://github.com/diysimon/ChartNexus.git cd ChartNexus pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts pnpm dev ``` Open `http://127.0.0.1:5173/quickstart.html`. You should see a bar chart with Jan, Feb and Mar, a complete JSON document, and `VALID · revision 1`. If port 5173 is busy, use the address Vite prints. Stop the server with `Ctrl+C`. ## 2. Change data and observe recovery In `data.rows`, change Jan's `revenue` to `200` and click Update; the revision increases. Replace the JSON temporarily with `{` and click again: `INVALID_JSON` appears and the last chart remains visible. You can also set `chart.encoding.y.field` to `missing` in a complete document: this reports `UNKNOWN_FIELD` while keeping the old chart. Restore a complete document and update again. Keep the same `id` while updating one chart. ## 3. Copy into your host Use the [page](../../examples/playground/quickstart.html), [component code](../../examples/playground/quickstart.ts), and [example ChartDocument](../../resources/recipes/chat-bar-03.json). Your browser bundler must resolve `@chartnexus/runtime` and its matching `echarts@6.1.0` peer. A host in this repository can use workspace dependencies; an external project needs trusted private packages or an internal registry supplied by a maintainer. Do not assume a public npm install exists. To rehearse actual installed artifacts on this machine, run `pnpm test:packages` from the repository root. It packs all eleven packages, installs them into an isolated temporary consumer, and prints `Retained isolated consumer: `. This does not publish packages. The consumer uses absolute local tarball paths and is not a portable distribution. To start its copied example, substitute the printed path below: ```sh cd /path/printed/for/chartnexus-consumer pnpm exec vite examples/playground --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort ``` Open `http://127.0.0.1:5174/quickstart.html`, then use `Ctrl+C` to stop it. For the automated installed-browser suite, first install Playwright Chromium with `pnpm exec playwright install chromium` in the repository and run `pnpm test:packages --browser` there. For example, in a Vite project that can already resolve these dependencies, save the recipe as `chart-document.json`, add a container to the page, and run this code from the entry module: ```html
``` ```js import { mountChart } from '@chartnexus/runtime'; import chartDocument from './chart-document.json'; const container = document.querySelector('#chart'); if (!container) throw new Error('Chart container is missing'); const mounted = mountChart(container, undefined, { chatPresentation: { theme: 'light', background: 'transparent', detailLevel: 'standard' }, }); if (!mounted.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(mounted.diagnostics)); const chart = mounted.value; const result = chart.update(chartDocument); if (!result.ok) console.error(result.diagnostics); // In your host's component-unmount cleanup: chart.dispose(); ``` Give the container nonzero width and height; call `mountChart(container, onSelect, { chatPresentation: settings })`; check `mounted.ok`; call `chart.update(document)` only with a complete ChartDocument and inspect the result; call `chart.dispose()` when the component unmounts. The example uses `pagehide` for cleanup; framework hosts should clean up on component unmount. Wait until a hidden container is measurable or use the [waiting mount coordinator](chat-host-quality.md). ## 4. Connect a model or GenUI host The application decides when to request a chart and supplies authorized data; the model returns complete JSON. The host buffers stream fragments before committing. For invalid output show diagnostics or a text/table fallback; do not invent facts. Concurrent updates require the optional ordered controller and real host revision; the simple example's `update` alone does not prevent stale responses. Maps and data references additionally require host-registered trusted assets and exact revisions. Choose the [OpenUI, A2UI or COSUI integration guide](genui-integrations.md), and see the [agent guide](agent-guide.md), [catalog](chart-catalog.md) and [responsibility boundary](product-boundary.md). These are tested pinned profiles, not all hosts/browsers/models. Before production, check your actual container, theme, network/CSP, error recovery, target devices, data authorization and operational monitoring.

# GenUI chart integration guide

[简体中文](../zh-CN/genui-integrations.md)

## Tested profiles

| Profile | Tested dependencies | Host | Entry point |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OpenUI Lang | `@openuidev/react-lang` 1.0.2, React 19.2.4, Zod 4.3.6 | React Renderer | `@chartnexus/adapter-openui` |
| COSUI JSON | `@cosui/cosmic-dynamic-ui` 1.0.0, `san` 3.15.5 | `UIJSON.compile` | `@chartnexus/adapter-cosui` |
| COSUI Markdown | `marklang` 1.0.1 | Marklang `renderToElement` | `@chartnexus/adapter-cosui/marklang` |
| A2UI v0.9 | `@a2ui/react` 0.9.1, `@a2ui/web_core` 0.9.2, React 19.2.4, Zod 3.25.76 | official MessageProcessor and React Surface | `@chartnexus/adapter-a2ui` |

The A2UI package versions are SDK versions; the message protocol is v0.9. OpenUI still uses Zod 4.3.6 and remains separately tested. These are experimental local workspace packages, not npm releases. All chart inputs are validated by the existing core with its limits and profile.

## OpenUI Lang

Register `createOpenUIChart(options)` in `createLibrary({ components: [chart], root: 'ChartNexusChart' })`, then pass the library to the upstream React `Renderer`. The component takes a JSON-encoded ChartDocument string. [The complete runnable host](../../examples/playground/openui.ts) shows the required OpenUI program, escaping, diagnostics, selection, streaming and lifecycle. Start it with `pnpm dev`, open `/openui.html`, and use the buttons to switch examples or provoke an error. OpenUI owns program parsing; the host must preserve its last committed response during streaming and remount when the chart ID changes. This is the tested OpenUI Lang profile, not standard A2UI.

## COSUI JSON

Register `createCosuiChart(options)` as `chartnexus-chart` in the host `components` map. Bind its `document` prop to a complete ChartDocument using the Dynamic UI data model. See [runnable host](../../examples/playground/cosui.ts). `onSelect` and `onDiagnostics` are host callbacks; the San component also fires `chart-select` and `chart-diagnostics`. `appendData` sets top-level keys; it is not a document patch. The host must buffer incomplete protocol messages and supply complete document replacements. Registry references require the host's trusted registry; change chart IDs by remounting.

## COSUI Marklang

Create `createMarklangCharts(container, options)`, call `update(source, complete)`, and call `dispose()` on teardown. Use `marklangDataSource(name, document)` to create a data block. Model-facing source is conceptually:

````markdown
::ml-chartnexus{data="sales"}

:::ml-data{name="sales"}
```json
{"schemaVersion":"0.1","id":"sales","mode":"echarts","option":{"series":[]}}
```
:::
````

The JSON above is illustrative; use the canonical schema and [bar recipe](../../resources/recipes/bar.json) to generate a complete supported document. Data names must be unique ASCII names of at most 64 characters, beginning with a letter and followed by letters, numbers, underscore or hyphen. Missing, duplicate or invalid chart data return diagnostics. Up to 16 charts and 1 MiB Markdown are allowed. Passing `complete: false` keeps existing charts untouched; the host owns assembly and deciding completeness. Complete input is validated and all charts are mounted in a measurable staging surface before an atomic swap; any staging failure retains the old charts.

**Trust boundary:** upstream Marklang may render HTML from Markdown. This adapter does not sanitize general Markdown or HTML; use trusted or separately sanitized Markdown and a suitable host security policy. SSR, hydration, arbitrary live streams, and behavior across other Markdown features are not verified.

## A2UI v0.9

`createA2uiChart(options)` returns a custom component implementation; register it in an A2UI v0.9 `Catalog` and process standard `createSurface`, `updateComponents`, `updateDataModel` and `deleteSurface` messages. See [runnable host](../../examples/playground/a2ui.ts). A model can emit a component like this, with the serialized ChartDocument bound at `/document`:

```json
{"id":"root","component":"ChartNexusChart","document":{"path":"/document"}}
```

The data model value is a **JSON string**, not JavaScript. For example, serialize the [bar recipe](../../resources/recipes/bar.json) and set it using `updateDataModel`. Incomplete or invalid JSON produces diagnostics and preserves the previous chart while the component stays mounted. Selection reaches the configured host callback; this is not an A2UI standard action event or transport to an agent. The host buffers and validates incoming protocol frames and handles surface removal. Ordered updates are optional, as described below; the default document mode does not provide revision ordering or deduplication.

## Evidence and limits

Local `pnpm check` and `pnpm test:browser` cover actual Dynamic UI, Marklang, and A2UI React hosts plus OpenUI regression. Examples cover intent/native modes, replacement, invalid input, recovery, selection and disposal; Marklang also tests incomplete input and duplicate/missing references; A2UI tests incomplete JSON. The pinned host tests and clean external package rehearsals are recorded in [support matrix](support-matrix.md); they do not prove real model-generated protocol programs, remote streaming transport, SSR/hydration, publication, mobile devices or other SDK versions. Bundle measurements are in [M4 evidence](trial-distribution.md). The Dynamic UI source repository has Apache-2.0 source headers, but the installed package declares ISC; clarify distribution notices before release.

### Optional ordered A2UI profile

Set `orderedUpdates: true` in `createA2uiChart` and bind `document` to a JSON-encoded ChartNexus operation rather than a ChartDocument. Capture the chart revision before asynchronous work; use `{ "operationId": "unique-id", "baseRevision": 0, "complete": true, "document": ... }` for a complete update, or omit `document` with `complete: false` for pending. `onUpdateReceipt` reports `applied`, `duplicate`, or `pending`; `onDiagnostics` reports conflicts and errors. Track the revision in successful receipts, reset it when remounting, and use a new ID for different work. See [ordered A2UI example](../../examples/playground/a2ui-ordered.ts). This is a ChartNexus host profile, not an A2UI protocol feature. The host must handle transport, message buffering and cancellation before publishing an operation; the component has no transport-level abort. The controller is session-local and has bounded deduplication as described in the [development guide](development.md).

### Buffering decoded chart streams

`createChartStreamBuffer(operationId, baseRevision)` helps the host assemble one decoded JSON ChartDocument. Capture the revision before starting, append decoded text fragments, and call `finish()` only after successful end-of-stream; publish its operation through the ordered A2UI profile. On cancellation or transport error, call `cancel()` and abort or close the transport separately. A failed buffer is terminal: create another for a retry. The buffer enforces a 1 MiB UTF-8 document limit and 16,384 fragments; the operation and registry must also fit the controller's shared 1 MiB inspection budget. Completion only parses JSON: the runtime validates the ChartDocument before rendering. The [example](../../examples/playground/a2ui-ordered.ts) uses a locally generated ReadableStream, not a model or an A2UI streaming transport. For byte streams, the host must use incremental decoding and flush its decoder.

### Ordered OpenUI and COSUI JSON profiles

Set `orderedUpdates: true` when creating either `createOpenUIChart` or `createCosuiChart`. OpenUI's `document` argument is a JSON-encoded operation string; COSUI JSON's `document` prop is the operation object. The host must capture the current chart revision before starting asynchronous work, supply its own unique operation ID, and track revisions through `onUpdateReceipt`. COSUI also emits `chart-receipt`. These are ChartNexus host extensions, not protocol-defined revisions or events. OpenUI continues to defer commits while its renderer reports streaming. Pending, stale and failed operations do not update the chart; successful duplicates return their existing receipt. The host is responsible for buffering, cancellation and choosing when to publish. See the [combined example](../../examples/playground/ordered-protocols.ts). COSUI Marklang does not use this profile.

### Chat presentation in GenUI hosts

`createA2uiChart`, `createOpenUIChart` and `createCosuiChart` accept optional host-owned `chatPresentation` settings. They use the same 0.2/0.3 intent chat profile as the runtime; without this option, existing behavior is unchanged. A2UI, OpenUI and COSUI JSON were tested locally with dark/transparent settings and ordered updates. Marklang accepts chatPresentation with transactional whole-document updates. Theme settings do not automatically track the host; a host must manage settings and trigger an update or remount. See the [chat presentation guide](chat-presentation.md).

## M1/M2 implementation

See [0.3 contracts and migration](contracts-03.md) and [chat host quality/support matrix](chat-host-quality.md) for current version discovery, dimensions, tables, lifecycle, legend retention and real local Ollama streaming evidence. Legacy spec evidence remains historical.

## M3 chart expansion

0.3 now supports radar, tree, Sankey and trusted regional maps in addition to the original seven types. See [contracts, host MapRegistry, resources and preview](chart-expansion-03.md). Browser/SVG/worker and four pinned upstream SDK paths have local evidence; M4 model evaluation and distribution remain separate. Fixed renderer-owned label callbacks preserve text literally; model callbacks remain forbidden.

title: 产品责任边界

# 产品边界与责任划分

[English](../en/product-boundary.md)

ChartNexus 提供版本化图表文档、校验与编译、浏览器与 SVG 渲染、固定版本的 GenUI 适配 profile，以及面向模型的资源。宿主提供完整数据或已授权的数据引用。输入经过可选的协议适配 → ChartDocument → 校验/编译 → 渲染器 → 宿主组件。不使用 MCP 或模型服务也可以直接使用渲染器。

| 责任 | ChartNexus | 宿主 / 数据 / 模型 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 是否画图、是否调用组件 | 描述支持的能力和输入 | 决定并调用组件 |
| 业务数据的真实性、来源和授权 | 校验支持的数据结构与引用，不推断事实 | 查询、授权并核实数据 |
| 展示已提供的数值 | 保留数值、单位、空值、身份与明确声明的转换；报告不支持的输入 | 选择明确的操作并提供合适的容器 |
| 错误、不完整或过期的输出 | 返回诊断；在所选运行时/适配器明确保证时保留上一张图 | 拼接完整消息，管理重试、顺序和降级 |
| 主题和信息密度 | 在可选聊天 profile 中提供受限的明暗主题、透明背景与五档密度 | 设置宿主策略并保证周围背景可读 |
| 模型接入 | 提供 Schema、能力、示例和诊断，验证资源可用性 | 选择和配置模型、提示词及工具；不保证模型调用或生成准确 |

项目不查询事实、不静默修改业务数据、不执行模型代码、不开放任意 ECharts 配置，也不保证兼容所有协议或模型。guarded native 校验是部分校验。Schema 校验不能证明事实正确、安全认证通过或选图合理。既有模型评测只反映特定设置，用于诊断，不是通用产品验收阈值。模型未选择组件或生成的事实不准确，不属于 ChartNexus 渲染错误。

生产接入前应验证具体宿主/SDK/浏览器、流式拼接、错误处理、资源限制、交付版本及运行策略。服务端渲染和远程服务还需要宿主侧隔离与访问控制；本地 stdio MCP 不能直接当公网服务。见[支持矩阵](support-matrix.md)和[快速接入](getting-started.md)。

# 图表与能力目录

[English](../en/chart-catalog.md)

实验性的 0.3 intent 支持以下 11 类有边界的图表。示例是合成数据，只展示契约，不是事实答案。以下链接均为完整的 0.3 配方；更早的 0.1/0.2 配方仍保留在清单中。生成时请使用对应类型的 0.3 分支 Schema。

| 图表 | 输入结构与主要限制 | 可运行配方 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 柱状 bar | 分类 x、数值 y；支持横向 | [0.3 柱状](../../resources/recipes/chat-bar-03.json) |
| 折线 line | 分类或明确的时间 x、数值 y；支持面积 | [0.3 折线](../../resources/recipes/line-03.json) |
| 饼图 pie | 分类和非负数值；不会虚构零总量占比 | [0.3 饼图](../../resources/recipes/pie-03.json) |
| 散点 scatter | 数值 x 和 y | [0.3 散点](../../resources/recipes/scatter-03.json) |
| 组合 combo | 一组柱和一条线，需满足坐标轴和单位规则 | [0.3 组合](../../resources/recipes/combo-03.json) |
| 漏斗 funnel | 分类及非负数值，不推断转化率 | [0.3 漏斗](../../resources/recipes/funnel-03.json) |
| 热力 heatmap | 分类 x/y、数值色阶；必须指定 min/max，不允许重复单元 | [0.3 热力](../../resources/recipes/heatmap-03.json) |
| 雷达 radar | 必须明确指标和范围 | [0.3 雷达](../../resources/recipes/radar-03.json) |
| 树 tree | 唯一节点 ID、父节点引用及单一无环根节点 | [0.3 树](../../resources/recipes/tree-03.json) |
| 桑基 sankey | 节点与非负、无环的连接 | [0.3 桑基](../../resources/recipes/sankey-03.json) |
| 地图 map | 区域数据、明确色阶范围及可信宿主地图资产与版本 | [0.3 地图](../../resources/recipes/map-03.json) |

启用聊天 profile 后，宿主可控制明/暗主题、透明或宿主指定背景及 minimal/simple/standard/detailed/comprehensive 五档密度，宿主设置优先。原生 ECharts 0.1 输入是独立模式，使用受限的部分校验。具体规则及验证版本见[契约](contracts-03.md)、[展示](chat-presentation.md)和[支持矩阵](support-matrix.md)。

执行 `pnpm dev`，打开 `/chat.html` 查看展示效果、`/expansion.html` 查看雷达/树/桑基/地图，打开 `/openui.html`、`/a2ui.html`、`/cosui.html`、`/marklang.html` 查看宿主集成。[配方清单](../../resources/recipes/manifest.json)列出资源 URI、反例和地图前置条件。

# Agent 接入与检索指南

[English](../en/agent-guide.md)

应用决定是否请求图表并提供已授权数据；ChartNexus 不查询事实，也不强制模型调用工具。向 Agent 提供宿主实际启用的 profile、可信数据/字段名与匹配 Schema，要求生成一个完整 JSON 文档。下面的合成配方不是用户业务问题的答案。

读取仓库的工具可从纯文本 [llms.txt](../../llms.txt) 或[中文索引](../../llms.zh-CN.txt)开始；这不代表文件已经部署到网站或一定被自动发现。两个索引均包含在检索语料中。

## 发现顺序

1. 读取宿主策略：允许的版本/图表类型、是否启用聊天展示或有序操作、已授权表/地图引用及大小限制。
2. 读取 `chartnexus://capabilities/basic-0.3`，再用 `{ "schemaVersion": "0.3", "chartType": "bar" }` 调用 `get_chart_schema`（按请求替换为受支持类型）。工具默认返回 0.1；单分支 Schema 不代表宿主一定允许该能力。
3. 读取 `chartnexus://recipes/manifest/0.1` 和匹配的配方 URI。11 类图表均有 0.3 配方；旧 0.2 配方应保持原版本，除非显式迁移。地图需要宿主注册资产；引用数据需要授权的宿主 registry 与精确 revision。
4. 把完整文档交给 `validate_chart`。失败时查看实际 `code` 和 JSON Pointer `path`，仅按宿主策略有限重试，不虚构业务数据。`compile_chart` 返回渲染计划；`render_chart` 返回会话内静态 SVG 资源，不是交互式浏览器组件。

## 0.3 配方查找

以下后缀接在 `chartnexus://recipes/` 后：bar → `chat-bar/0.3`；line → `line/0.3`；pie → `pie/0.3`；scatter → `scatter/0.3`；combo → `combo/0.3`；funnel → `funnel/0.3`；heatmap → `heatmap/0.3`；radar → `radar/0.3`；tree → `tree/0.3`；sankey → `sankey/0.3`；map → `map/0.3`。地图配方需要宿主注册 `two-regions@1` 合成资产，配方本身不能注册资产。复用前检查清单和能力限制。

## 可复制的提示词模板

```text
宿主已请求生成图表。输出一个完整的 ChartDocument JSON 对象。
只使用给定的允许版本、Schema、字段、数值和已授权引用。
不要虚构数据，也不要在图表文档中包含可执行函数、回调或 URL；只在明确要求时聚合或排序。
保留 null、单位和数据身份；无法完成时通过宿主自己的响应格式说明。
宿主 profile：<宿主提供的配置>；Schema：<Schema 或引用>；
允许的数据：<宿主提供的字段和数据行，或可信引用>；用户请求：<请求>。
```

宿主决定自己的响应外壳并处理拒绝/不画图状态；这些不是 ChartDocument 字段。OpenUI/A2UI/COSUI 接入需遵循对应[集成指南](genui-integrations.md)要求的 JSON 字符串或操作信封。流式内容由宿主拼接，只传入完整文档。有序 profile 的 operation ID 和当前 base revision 由宿主提供，不可虚构。

## RAG 与训练使用

`chartnexus://resources/index/0.1` 列出来源、版本、语言、许可证及源文件字节哈希。`chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1` 提供包含 `body` 的逐行 JSON 记录；按 `language` 和 `capabilityIds` 筛选，再按宿主 profile 约束读取相关 Schema、目录和示例。`schemaVersion` 表示资源主要版本上下文，条目也可能列出其他兼容能力 ID。`uri: null` 的条目可从检索语料读取，不是独立 MCP 资源。仓库内可直接读取 [JSONL](../../resources/model-retrieval.jsonl)。源示例为 Apache-2.0 合成数据；保留来源与许可证，不要训练或索引私人数据及留出评测输出。可复用资源不代表模型已经训练，也不代表 MCP 客户端已经选择该资源。

独立的[合成输入／输出样例对](../../resources/model-examples.jsonl)也可从 `chartnexus://resources/examples/0.1` 读取：11 类图表 × 中英文。每条记录包含明确的输入数据／图表配置、完整输出文档、源配方哈希、许可证及宿主前置条件。这些样例展示文档序列化和对输入的忠实处理，不训练或评估独立选图和事实查询。语料整体在索引中标记 `mul`，按语言筛选时应包含它，再选择单条的 `en` 或 `zh-CN` 记录。这 22 对只是入门样例，不代表训练有效或覆盖全面。用于训练或 few-shot 提示前，应自行审核来源与适用性。

在仓库根目录可不依赖 MCP 客户端检查中文 0.3 指南记录：

```js
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
const records = readFileSync('resources/model-retrieval.jsonl', 'utf8')
  .trim().split('\n').map((line) => JSON.parse(line));
const guides = records.filter((item) => item.language === 'zh-CN'
  && item.capabilityIds.includes('basic-0.3')
  && ['agent-guide', 'chart-catalog'].includes(item.id));
console.log(guides.map(({ id, source, contentHash }) => ({ id, source, contentHash })));
```

将代码保存为 `.mjs` 文件，在仓库根目录用 Node 运行。检索系统应索引 `body`、保留关联元数据，并只选择宿主 profile 允许的资源。

见[模型入口](model-entry.md)、[图表目录](chart-catalog.md)、[责任边界](product-boundary.md)和 [CLI/MCP 指南](agent-integration.md)。

--- doc_id: getting-started version: "0.1" status: experimental updated: 2026-11-01 language: zh-CN --- # Quick start: embed a chart in a chatbot [English](../en/getting-started.md) 这份教程从本仓库运行一个真实浏览器组件，不需要模型密钥、Ollama 或 MCP。0.3 仍是实验版本，包目前是私有 workspace 包，不能假设可从 npm 公网安装。 ## 1. 准备并运行 安装 Node 22.22.3（或已验证的 24.22.1）、pnpm 11.25.0 和 Git；在终端执行： ```sh git clone https://github.com/diysimon/ChartNexus.git cd ChartNexus pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts pnpm dev ``` 在浏览器打开 `http://127.0.0.1:5173/quickstart.html`。应看到带 Jan、Feb、Mar 的柱状图、完整 JSON 和 `VALID · revision 1`。若 5173 被占用，请使用 Vite 实际打印的地址。按 `Ctrl+C` 停止服务。 ## 2. 修改数据并体验失败恢复 在页面 JSON 的 `data.rows` 中把 `Jan` 的 `revenue` 改为 `200`，点击“更新图表”；状态 revision 增加。把 JSON 暂时改成 `{` 再点击，状态显示 `INVALID_JSON`，上一张图保留。也可以在完整文档中把 `chart.encoding.y.field` 改为 `missing`：这次会得到 `UNKNOWN_FIELD`，旧图仍保留。恢复完整文档后可以继续更新。JSON 中的 `id` 在同一图表更新期间保持稳定。 ## 3. 复制到自己的宿主 查看并复制[页面](../../examples/playground/quickstart.html)、[组件代码](../../examples/playground/quickstart.ts)和[示例 ChartDocument](../../resources/recipes/chat-bar-03.json)。在浏览器构建工具中，宿主需要可解析 `@chartnexus/runtime` 和匹配的 `echarts@6.1.0` peer。仓库内宿主可使用 workspace 依赖；外部项目需要先由维护者提供可信的私有包/内部制品仓库。不要把尚不存在的公网 npm 安装命令当成可用方式。在这台机器上体验实际安装包：从仓库根目录执行 `pnpm test:packages`。脚本打包全部 11 个包，在隔离临时消费者中安装，并打印 `Retained isolated consumer: `；它不是发布命令。消费者引用本机绝对 tarball 路径，不是可移植的发布包。把下方路径替换为打印出来的位置，启动其复制的示例： ```sh cd /path/printed/for/chartnexus-consumer pnpm exec vite examples/playground --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5174 --strictPort ``` 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:5174/quickstart.html`，完成后按 `Ctrl+C`。如需自动运行安装后浏览器套件，先在仓库中执行 `pnpm exec playwright install chromium`，再执行 `pnpm test:packages --browser`。 例如，在已能解析这些依赖的 Vite 项目中，将配方保存为 `chart-document.json`，在页面添加容器，并从入口模块执行以下代码： ```html
``` ```js import { mountChart } from '@chartnexus/runtime'; import chartDocument from './chart-document.json'; const container = document.querySelector('#chart'); if (!container) throw new Error('Chart container is missing'); const mounted = mountChart(container, undefined, { chatPresentation: { theme: 'light', background: 'transparent', detailLevel: 'standard' }, }); if (!mounted.ok) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(mounted.diagnostics)); const chart = mounted.value; const result = chart.update(chartDocument); if (!result.ok) console.error(result.diagnostics); // In your host's component-unmount cleanup: chart.dispose(); ``` 代码的关键步骤：为容器设置非零宽高；调用 `mountChart(container, onSelect, { chatPresentation: settings })`；检查 `mounted.ok`；只对完整 ChartDocument 调用 `chart.update(document)` 并检查结果；组件卸载时调用 `chart.dispose()`。样例使用 `pagehide` 演示清理，真实框架应在组件卸载时清理。隐藏容器先等待可测量尺寸，或使用[等待挂载协调器](chat-host-quality.md)。 ## 4. 接入模型或 GenUI 宿主 业务后端决定何时请求图表，提供经过授权的数据，模型负责输出完整 JSON；宿主缓冲流式片段，验证完成后再更新。无效输出显示诊断或文字/表格回退；不要补造事实。并发更新需要宿主使用有序更新控制器及真实 revision，不能直接依靠示例的简单 `update` 防止旧响应覆盖新响应。地图与数据引用还需宿主注册可信资产及精确版本。 选择 [OpenUI、A2UI 或 COSUI 接入指南](genui-integrations.md)，并查看[模型与 Agent 指南](agent-guide.md)、[能力目录](chart-catalog.md)及[责任边界](product-boundary.md)。这些适配 profile 有固定版本验证，不代表所有宿主、浏览器或模型已验证。上线前在真实应用检查容器、主题、网络/CSP、错误恢复、目标设备、数据权限与运行监控。

body:
---
doc_id: genui-integrations
version: "0.2"
status: experimental
updated: 2026-11-01
language: zh-CN
---

# GenUI 图表集成指南

[English](../en/genui-integrations.md)

## 已测试的 profile

| Profile | 测试依赖 | 宿主 | 入口 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OpenUI Lang | `@openuidev/react-lang` 1.0.2、React 19.2.4、Zod 4.3.6 | React Renderer | `@chartnexus/adapter-openui` |
| COSUI JSON | `@cosui/cosmic-dynamic-ui` 1.0.0、`san` 3.15.5 | `UIJSON.compile` | `@chartnexus/adapter-cosui` |
| COSUI Markdown | `marklang` 1.0.1 | Marklang `renderToElement` | `@chartnexus/adapter-cosui/marklang` |
| A2UI v0.9 | `@a2ui/react` 0.9.1、`@a2ui/web_core` 0.9.2、React 19.2.4、Zod 3.25.76 | 官方 MessageProcessor 和 React Surface | `@chartnexus/adapter-a2ui` |

A2UI 包版本是 SDK 版本，消息协议为 v0.9。OpenUI 继续使用 Zod 4.3.6，并单独回归测试。这些是本地实验性工作区包，不代表 npm 发布。所有图表输入均由现有 core 校验，受其能力 profile 和资源上限约束。

## OpenUI Lang

在 `createLibrary({ components: [chart], root: 'ChartNexusChart' })` 中注册 `createOpenUIChart(options)`，再把 library 传给上游 React `Renderer`。组件接收 JSON 编码的 ChartDocument 字符串。[完整可运行宿主](../../examples/playground/openui.ts)展示 OpenUI 程序、转义、诊断、选择、流式和生命周期。运行 `pnpm dev` 后打开 `/openui.html`，使用页面按钮切换示例或触发错误。OpenUI 负责解析程序；流式期间宿主应保留上次提交的响应，图表 ID 改变时重新挂载。这是已测试的 OpenUI Lang profile，不等于标准 A2UI。

## COSUI JSON

在宿主 `components` 映射中将 `createCosuiChart(options)` 注册为 `chartnexus-chart`；通过 Dynamic UI 数据模型将完整 ChartDocument 绑定到 `document` 属性。参见[可运行宿主](../../examples/playground/cosui.ts)。`onSelect`、`onDiagnostics` 是宿主回调；San 组件也会发出 `chart-select` 和 `chart-diagnostics`。`appendData` 设置顶层字段，并非图表文档 patch。宿主必须缓冲不完整协议消息并提交完整文档替换。引用数据由宿主提供可信 registry；更换图表 ID 时重新挂载。

## COSUI Marklang

使用 `createMarklangCharts(container, options)`，调用 `update(source, complete)`，销毁时调用 `dispose()`。使用 `marklangDataSource(name, document)` 创建数据块。面向模型的输入形态例如：

````markdown
::ml-chartnexus{data="sales"}

:::ml-data{name="sales"}
```json
{"schemaVersion":"0.1","id":"sales","mode":"echarts","option":{"series":[]}}
```
:::
````

示例 JSON 仅展示结构；完整有效文档请参照权威 schema 和 [柱状图 recipe](../../resources/recipes/bar.json)。数据名必须唯一，最多 64 个 ASCII 字符，以字母开头，其后仅允许字母、数字、下划线、连字符。缺失、重复或无效的图表数据产生诊断。最多 16 张图、1 MiB Markdown。传入 `complete: false` 时不改动现有图表；片段组装和完整性判定由宿主负责。完整输入先校验，并在可测量暂存区挂载全部图表后原子替换；任何暂存失败均保留旧图。

**信任边界：**上游 Marklang 可能渲染 Markdown 中的 HTML。本适配器不净化通用 Markdown 或 HTML；宿主应仅传入可信内容或另行净化，并配置适当的安全策略。SSR、水合、真实流式传输以及其他 Markdown 功能尚未验证。

## A2UI v0.9

`createA2uiChart(options)` 返回自定义组件实现，注册到 A2UI v0.9 `Catalog` 后处理标准 `createSurface`、`updateComponents`、`updateDataModel`、`deleteSurface` 消息。参见[可运行宿主](../../examples/playground/a2ui.ts)。模型可生成如下组件，并将序列化 ChartDocument 绑定到 `/document`：

```json
{"id":"root","component":"ChartNexusChart","document":{"path":"/document"}}
```

数据模型中的值是 **JSON 字符串**，不是 JavaScript。例如将[柱状图 recipe](../../resources/recipes/bar.json) 序列化后用 `updateDataModel` 设置。只要组件保持挂载，不完整或无效 JSON 会返回诊断并保留上一张图。选择事件通过配置的宿主回调提供；这不是 A2UI 标准 action 事件，也不自动传输给 Agent。宿主负责缓冲和校验协议帧及处理 surface 删除。默认文档模式不提供版本排序或去重；可选择下述顺序更新模式。

## 证据与限制

本地 `pnpm check`、`pnpm test:browser` 覆盖真实 Dynamic UI、Marklang、A2UI React 宿主和 OpenUI 回归。示例验证 intent/原生模式、替换、无效输入、恢复、选择和释放；Marklang 另测不完整输入及重复/缺失引用，A2UI 另测不完整 JSON。固定宿主测试及干净外部安装的证据见[支持矩阵](support-matrix.md)，不能证明真实模型生成的协议程序、远端流式传输、SSR/水合、发布、移动设备或其他 SDK 版本。体积实测见[M4证据](trial-distribution.md)。Dynamic UI 源码仓库标记 Apache-2.0，但安装包元数据标记 ISC，发布前需厘清分发声明。

### 可选的 A2UI 顺序更新 profile

在 `createA2uiChart` 中设置 `orderedUpdates: true`，将 `document` 绑定到 JSON 编码的 ChartNexus operation，而非 ChartDocument。异步工作开始前捕获图表版本；完整更新使用 `{ "operationId": "unique-id", "baseRevision": 0, "complete": true, "document": ... }`，未完成时使用 `complete: false` 且不带 `document`。`onUpdateReceipt` 返回 `applied`、`duplicate` 或 `pending`，`onDiagnostics` 报告冲突和错误。宿主从成功回执维护版本，重新挂载后重置，并为不同任务使用新 ID。参见 [A2UI 顺序更新示例](../../examples/playground/a2ui-ordered.ts)。这是 ChartNexus 宿主 profile，并非 A2UI 协议特性。传输、消息缓冲及发布操作前的取消由宿主负责；组件不提供传输级取消。控制器仅作用于当前会话，去重受资源上限约束，详见[开发指南](development.md)。

### 缓冲已解码的图表流

`createChartStreamBuffer(operationId, baseRevision)` 帮助宿主拼接一个已解码的 JSON ChartDocument。工作开始前捕获版本，追加文本片段，并仅在流成功结束后调用 `finish()`；将其返回的 operation 交给 A2UI 顺序更新 profile。取消或传输错误时调用 `cancel()`，并由宿主另行中止或关闭传输。失败后的缓冲器不可复用，重试需要新建。缓冲器限制文档为 1 MiB UTF-8、最多 16384 个片段；operation 和 registry 还须共同满足控制器的 1 MiB 检查上限。完成时只解析 JSON，运行时会在渲染前校验 ChartDocument。[示例](../../examples/playground/a2ui-ordered.ts)使用本地生成的 ReadableStream，并非模型或 A2UI 流式传输。对于字节流，宿主须增量解码并在结束时刷新解码器。

### OpenUI 和 COSUI JSON 顺序更新 profile

创建 `createOpenUIChart` 或 `createCosuiChart` 时设置 `orderedUpdates: true`。OpenUI 的 `document` 参数是 JSON 编码的 operation 字符串；COSUI JSON 的 `document` 属性直接传入 operation 对象。宿主必须在异步工作开始前捕获当前图表版本、提供唯一操作 ID，并通过 `onUpdateReceipt` 跟踪版本；COSUI 同时触发 `chart-receipt`。这是 ChartNexus 宿主扩展，并非协议定义的版本或事件。OpenUI 的 renderer 报告流式状态期间仍会推迟提交。未完成、过期及失败操作不会更新图表；已成功操作的重复投递返回已有回执。缓冲、取消和发布时机由宿主负责。参见[组合示例](../../examples/playground/ordered-protocols.ts)。COSUI Marklang 不使用此 profile。

### GenUI 宿主中的聊天展示

`createA2uiChart`、`createOpenUIChart` 和 `createCosuiChart` 接受可选、由宿主持有的 `chatPresentation` 设置，并使用 runtime 相同的 0.2/0.3 intent 聊天 profile；不传时保持原行为。A2UI、OpenUI 和 COSUI JSON 已在本机验证深色透明设置与顺序更新。Marklang 已接受此设置，采用整个文档的事务更新。主题不会自动追踪宿主；宿主需要管理设置并触发更新或重新挂载。详见[聊天展示指南](chat-presentation.md)。

## M1/M2 实施

当前版本发现、迁移、尺寸、数据表、生命周期、图例保留及真实本地 Ollama 流式证据见 [0.3 契约](contracts-03.md) 与 [聊天宿主质量/支持矩阵](chat-host-quality.md)。旧 spec 的验证记录保留为历史证据。

## M3 图表扩充

0.3 在原有七类基础上新增雷达、树、桑基和可信区域地图。见[契约、宿主 MapRegistry、模型资源和预览](chart-expansion-03.md)。浏览器/SVG/worker 与四种固定上游 SDK 路径已有本地证据；M4 模型评测和分发仍是独立工作。固定渲染器标签回调保留原文，仍禁止模型回调。

# Four bounded chart types in 0.3

[简体中文](../zh-CN/chart-expansion-03.md)

## Contract and supported scope

Radar, node-link tree, Sankey and regional map extend experimental **0.3 intent**. All eleven branches now compile; 0.1/0.2 and native-mode capabilities remain unchanged. Read `get_chart_schema({schemaVersion:"0.3",chartType:"radar"})` for an exact branch and `list_capabilities` for limits. Full native ECharts configuration, treemaps, automatic data collection and online maps are outside this profile.

| Type | Source and rules | Identity and presentation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| radar | One ordinary-table row per item; 1–6 unique nonempty item names, 3–8 distinct numeric indicators, explicit finite min < max and optional units. Null, missing, duplicate items and out-of-range values fail. | Source rows or optional row keys; independent indicator ranges are stated in the summary. No normalization or inferred ranges. Multiple items require a legend. |
| tree | Ordinary table with id/parentId/label field references. One root with null parent; 1–1000 unique IDs, existing parents, acyclic/reachable, root depth 0 and maximum depth 16. Labels may repeat. | Stable node IDs. Optional initialDepth 0–2 (default 2). Compatible topology/encoding preserves collapsed state across reorder/update/resize; topology changes reset it. No value is inferred from child count. |
| sankey | Graph data has independent inline/reference nodes and links tables, resolved atomically within a combined 1 MiB budget. ≤200 nodes/1000 edges, unique node IDs, valid endpoints, no directed cycles/self-links/duplicate directed pairs, finite nonnegative weights. | Node ID and ordered-endpoint edge ID; duplicate display labels remain distinct. Zero edges and nodes without positive flow are not drawn but stay in full tables. Incoming/outgoing/difference are reported; no conservation or percentage assumption. |
| map | Ordinary table, exact region/value fields, mapRef id/revision and explicit finite colorDomain min < max. Duplicate/unknown regions and non-null out-of-range values fail. ≤1000 rows. | Stable region IDs; absent source row has rowIndex null. Zero is a measured value, null and absent use a missing-data color. Raw and rendered tables distinguish provided/absent. |

New branches reject legend overrides: radar requires its item legend, while tree/Sankey/map use labels or a continuous scale. Tree/Sankey also reject dataLabels overrides because node labels are required; radar/map permit dataLabels.show.

All inputs are JSON. Fields/values are not silently renamed, normalized, sorted or summed. Scalar source tables and all original graph links remain accessible and appear in SVG metadata. Radar indicator units are descriptive and never convert source values.

## Rendering, state and exports

Two host themes, transparent background and five detail levels use the shared chat presentation planner. Required radar legends, tree/Sankey labels and map scales remain available; dense layouts may use explicit browser table fallback or return SVG EXPORT_LIMIT. Diagrams below 320px use fallback rather than squeeze labels. Full raw text remains in tables if visual labels are truncated. Map labels use the declared theme surface behind text when enabled, rather than assuming all region fills provide text contrast.

The shared ECharts bridge installs fixed Sankey label/tooltip callbacks that return source text literally, including ECharts template markers. RenderPlan remains JSON; no model callbacks or code are accepted or executed. Stable internal IDs are separate from display labels.

Tree SVG is an explicitly labelled **initial collapsed overview**, with full source hierarchy in title/metadata. It does not export the browser's current expansion state or claim that every descendant is visible. Browser expansion changes neither data nor revision; changed topology resets expansion. Chart selection events use eventVersion 0.3 with identity node/edge/region and source row mapping; radar retains row/key selection. Empty or zero-flow Sankey inputs draw no invented flow. Zoom retention is unsupported.

## Trusted map assets

`@chartnexus/echarts` is a shared local workspace package with the existing ECharts 6.1.0 peer. `createMapAsset(input)` clones and validates a host asset, normalizes FeatureCollection geometry, and computes a synchronous SHA-256 shared by Node and browsers. Required host fields: id, revision, coordinateSystem:"WGS84", license, provenance, geoJSON. Each feature has a unique properties.name matching the document's region key. Only Polygon/MultiPolygon with finite 2D coordinates, longitude ±180/latitude ±90, closed nondegenerate rings are accepted. No CRS conversion, SVG maps, geometry collections or antimeridian-crossing segments. This is bounded shape validation, not comprehensive GIS topology certification (for example, it does not prove rings never self-intersect). Hosts remain responsible for geometry correctness and redistribution rights.

Limits are ≤5 MiB host asset JSON, 20000 total coordinate points and 1000 features per asset. Shared ECharts registrations are capped at eight revisions and 20 MiB normalized geometry per module instance. Names include id/revision/hash. Reusing identical assets does not consume capacity; changing geometry under an existing id/revision is rejected. Since ECharts cannot unregister maps, disposal does not free this capacity; use a fresh rendering process/worker when exhausted. The registration checks detect external overwrites within the reserved namespace. Do not directly register maps under `chartnexus:` names.

```ts
import { createMapAsset, mapCatalog } from '@chartnexus/echarts';
import { mountChart } from '@chartnexus/runtime';
import { compileChart } from '@chartnexus/core';
// assetInput is trusted host-owned JSON, never a model tool argument.
const prepared = createMapAsset(assetInput);
if (!prepared.ok) throw new Error('Invalid host map');
const maps = { [prepared.value.id]: prepared.value };
const plan = compileChart(chartDocument, dataRegistry, mapCatalog(maps));
const mounted = mountChart(container, onSelect, { maps, chatPresentation: {} });
if (mounted.ok) mounted.value.update(chartDocument, dataRegistry);
```

Pass the same `maps` host option to renderSvg, createAgentService, or an OpenUI/A2UI/COSUI/Marklang adapter. Core receives only metadata/region keys through MapCatalog. The renderer revalidates geometry/hash; the Node worker receives the host snapshot and performs the same checks under its existing deadline/memory/output budgets. Agent list_capabilities exposes registered map metadata/keys, never coordinates. Default CLI/MCP processes have no maps; a map recipe requires a configured host. No model argument can register a map, select a file/URL or bypass the host registry.

The [authored rectangles](../../examples/maps/two-regions.json) are Apache-2.0 synthetic test data, not administrative boundaries. The public [map recipe](../../resources/recipes/map-03.json) refers to two-regions@1, and its manifest declares the host requirement. No real boundary assets are bundled or downloaded.

## Preview, resources and evidence

Run `pnpm dev` and open `/expansion.html` to switch chart/theme/detail/width, edit complete JSON, inspect full data and click marks. Existing upstream demos accept `?m3=radar|tree|sankey|map` for the same authored fixtures. [Radar](../../resources/recipes/radar-03.json), [tree](../../resources/recipes/tree-03.json), [Sankey](../../resources/recipes/sankey-03.json) and map recipes, negative mutations, capability limits, diagnostics and MCP/RAG copies are generated from canonical resources.

See [SPEC-0035](../../specs/0035-chart-expansion/spec.md) and [acceptance evidence](../../specs/0035-chart-expansion/tasks.md). Local compiler/browser/SVG/worker and pinned upstream SDK checks are distinct from real-model success. M4 scoped evaluation, all-package clean installs, performance baselines and remote CI are recorded in [M4 evidence](trial-distribution.md); npm publication has not occurred. No universal protocol/model or broad accessibility certification is claimed.

# ChartDocument 0.3 and core boundaries

0.3 is experimental and intent-only. Its canonical schema has eleven type-specific branches. All eleven compiler types are implemented: bar, line, pie, scatter, combo, funnel, heatmap, radar, tree, Sankey and map. Map rendering requires a trusted host asset. See the [four new chart contracts](chart-expansion-03.md). A schema-valid document is not a renderer-support claim.

## Contract and discovery

`chartDocument03Schema` and `projectChartSchema03(type)` come from `@chartnexus/schema`; projections are exact branches from the same union. Ordinary charts/radar/tree use inline or referenced tables. Sankey uses `{kind:"graph",nodes:<table>,links:<table>}`. Maps use a table plus trusted `chart.mapRef:{id,revision}` and explicit color domain. Heatmap requires its heatmap configuration structurally. Unknown fields are rejected, with property paths in diagnostics. Numeric ranges, references, keys and supported combinations still need compilation.

MCP: `get_chart_schema({schemaVersion:"0.3",chartType:"bar"})`. CLI: `pnpm cli schema --schema-version 0.3 --chart-type bar`. The default schema tool remains 0.1. Full schema and implemented capabilities have `/0.3` resources; all eleven types appear in `charts` with type-specific and host-asset constraints. `getChartInputContract({schemaVersion:"0.3",chatPresentation:true})` returns a complete matching example; its default recommendation remains 0.2 for existing hosts.

## Explicit migration and identity

`migrateIntentTo03(document, registry?)` validates and compiles the old intent before checking the converted 0.3 structure. It changes only the version and converts `{theme:{id,version:"1"}}` to `{theme:"light"|"dark"}`. Unsupported or type-irrelevant old fields are rejected, never silently discarded. Native documents stay on 0.1; migration is never automatic.

Optional `data.keyField` names a declared field containing unique nonempty strings up to 256 characters. Source order and numeric values do not change. `RenderPlan.rowKeys` follows the same sorting/selection mapping as rowIndices. 0.3 events declare `eventVersion:"0.3"`; keyed selections have `identity:"key"`, rowKey and current rowIndex. Without keys they remain positional; aggregated selections retain aggregate metadata rather than fabricated row keys. Nonfatal notices are structured code/severity/path/message with optional params. M3 adds node/edge/region identities for tree, Sankey and map; see the expansion guide.

## Internal responsibilities and evaluation foundation

Core now separates version validation, data-table resolution, legacy compilation, explicit transforms, temporal parsing, combo/funnel/heatmap handlers and presentation. The dispatcher exposes versions without importing DOM/network/model SDKs. Existing chart reuse inside the legacy 0.2 implementation is preserved for numeric equivalence; the four M3 types use independent compilers.

M0 source/option/row-index golden fixtures and existing aggregation, temporal, unit and failure tests guard extraction. `scripts/evaluation-harness.mjs` separates model-visible prompts from expected source hashes/rendered values, records initial versus at-most-two-repair outcomes and requires model/settings/compiler provenance. Its synthetic tests are harness tests, not held-out model results. Actual private suites must stay out of resources/retrieval; [M4 evidence](trial-distribution.md) records the later completed scoped run.

See [M1 spec](../../specs/0033-contracts-core/spec.md) and [tasks](../../specs/0033-contracts-core/tasks.md).

# Chat host quality and support matrix

## Presentation and access

Chat is host opt-in for 0.2/0.3 intent. `resolvePresentation(plan,{width,height,target,theme})` is pure; browser runtime supplies current content dimensions and SVG supplies requested dimensions. Without dimensions, compileChatChart retains its declared default styling rather than claiming responsive layout. The bounded layout reserves title, legend, axes and heatmap scale space. Dense labels can be suppressed with a notice even when explicitly requested; full raw values remain accessible. Widths below 240px, narrow dual axes and insufficient plot space use an explicit browser table fallback. SVG returns `EXPORT_LIMIT` when mandatory content cannot fit; increase dimensions rather than silently dropping it.

The shared light/dark token set is checked on declared white/#111827 surfaces. Transparent backgrounds require a matching host surface; arbitrary backgrounds are not certified. Normal text targets 4.5:1 and essential palette/axis colors 3:1. Animations remain disabled. Native HTML buttons/details provide keyboard access; tables paginate source rows in groups of 50 without dropping them, preserve null and units, and rendered marks include aggregation/source mapping. SVG includes a title and escaped JSON metadata containing full source and rendered tables. Hosts can read this metadata; SVG itself is static.

Browser controls are owned siblings of the chart container and are removed on disposal. Host CSS must allow them to remain visible and reachable. Legend selection is retained by semantic keys when chart type/encoding/units are compatible. Removed keys disappear, new keys are visible, incompatible changes emit `STATE_RESET`. Reserved JavaScript legend keys receive invisible rendering aliases while accessible labels and source values stay original. Zoom retention is not a supported profile.

## Lifecycle and transactions

`mountChart` still fails immediately for zero size. `observeChartMount` lets adapters wait, initialize one runtime when measurable and cancel observation on disposal. They retain the latest complete valid pending input; partial/invalid input never becomes a committed revision. Marklang also waits for a measurable container and stages all charts offscreen at the content width. Only a successful complete staging replaces the old nodes. Failure disposes staging alone. Limits are 16 charts, 1 MiB Markdown and a combined 1 MiB parsed input/registry budget, with temporary old/new coexistence bounded by two accepted documents.

Resize uses a snapshot of the last compiled plan and does not advance data/chart revision. Callback exceptions are reported separately; failed rendering attempts restoration. A `RENDER_RECOVERY_FAILED` diagnostic requires remounting. Marklang replaces whole documents, so interaction retention and per-chart revisions do not span those replacements.

## Streaming

`createChartStreamBuffer` now lives in runtime and retains the A2UI compatibility export. It buffers decoded JSON; it does not prove transport completion. `readOllamaStream` incrementally decodes strict UTF-8 NDJSON, enforces a 4 MiB wire budget and 1 MiB document budget, and requires `done:true` with `done_reason:"stop"`. Truncated, missing-terminal, malformed, aborted or extra-after-terminal responses never return a completed operation.

The local Ollama page uses the same-origin proxy with `stream:true`, a 120-second request deadline, cancellation, generation epochs and starting chart revisions. Manual edits invalidate stale generated results. It permits two bounded repairs and records attempts separately. One real synthetic qwen3.5:9b run passed first try, preserved values [3,5], and cancellation passed; see [evidence](../../specs/0034-chat-host-quality/ollama-verification.json). This is a smoke test, not a provider comparison or factual-data retrieval service. SSE is not an Ollama transport supported by this decoder; other transports must supply their own framing before using the neutral buffer.

## Pinned local host matrix

| Host | Representation/completion | Chat/theme/table | Zero size | Ordered operations | Legend retention |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OpenUI react-lang 1.0.2 / React 19.2.4 | JSON string; upstream streaming=false | yes | waits | host opt-in | compatible updates |
| A2UI React 0.9.1 / web_core 0.9.2 | resolved DynamicString; host completed operation | yes | waits | host opt-in | compatible updates |
| COSUI Dynamic UI 1.0.0 / San 3.15.5 | document object; host complete input | yes | waits | host opt-in | compatible updates |
| Marklang 1.0.1 | named data/directive; explicit complete=true | yes | waits for transaction | explicitly rejected | resets on whole-document swap |

Selection, validation errors, valid recovery and disposal use the shared runtime and pinned real SDK fixtures. Marklang parses trusted/sanitized Markdown only; this work does not sanitize arbitrary HTML. No upstream-standard guarantee is inferred from ChartNexus envelopes. Remote hosts, hydration, other SDK versions, mobile certification and broad accessibility certification remain unverified. See [M2 spec](../../specs/0034-chat-host-quality/spec.md).

## M3 chart expansion

0.3 now supports radar, tree, Sankey and trusted regional maps in addition to the original seven types. See [contracts, host MapRegistry, resources and preview](chart-expansion-03.md). Browser/SVG/worker and four pinned upstream SDK paths have local evidence; M4 model evaluation and distribution remain separate. Fixed renderer-owned label callbacks preserve text literally; model callbacks remain forbidden.

# 0.3 的四类有界图表

[English](../en/chart-expansion-03.md)

## 契约与支持范围

雷达、节点连线树、桑基和区域地图扩展实验性 **0.3 intent**。十一种分支现均可编译，0.1/0.2 和原生模式的能力范围不变。通过 `get_chart_schema({schemaVersion:"0.3",chartType:"radar"})` 获取精确分支，`list_capabilities` 获取限制。完整 ECharts 配置、矩形树图、自动采集数据和在线地图不在本 profile 内。

| 类型 | 数据及规则 | 身份与展示 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| radar | 普通表每行一个对象；1–6 个唯一非空名称、3–8 个不同数值指标、显式有限 min < max 和可选单位。拒绝 null、缺失、重名和越界。 | 原始行或可选行键；摘要说明各指标独立范围，不归一化、不猜范围。多对象需要图例。 |
| tree | 普通表 id/parentId/label 字段引用；唯一根的 parent 为 null，1–1000 个唯一 ID、合法父节点、无环且可达，根深度0、最大16。label 可重复。 | 稳定节点 ID。initialDepth 可选0–2，默认2；拓扑/编码相同时重排、更新、resize 保留折叠状态，拓扑变化重置。不把子节点数当数值。 |
| sankey | graph 含独立 inline/reference 的 nodes/links 表，原子解析且合计≤1MiB。≤200 节点/1000 边，唯一节点 ID、合法端点、无有向环/自环/重复有向边、有限非负权。 | 节点 ID 和有序端点对边 ID；重复显示标签保持独立。零边及无正流量节点不绘制，但完整表保留。报告流入/流出/差额，不推断守恒或百分比。 |
| map | 普通表、明确 region/value 字段、mapRef id/revision、显式有限 colorDomain min < max。拒绝重复/未知区域及非 null 越界值，≤1000 行。 | 稳定区域 ID；没有来源行时 rowIndex 为 null。0 是实测值，null 和缺失用缺失色，原始/渲染表区分 provided/absent。 |

所有输入为 JSON，不静默重命名、归一化、排序或求和。完整源表和原始图边可访问，并写入 SVG 元信息。雷达指标单位仅描述数据，不转换原始值。

## 渲染、状态与导出

两主题、透明背景和五档展示复用聊天展示规划器。必要雷达图例、树/桑基标签和地图色阶保留；密集布局可显式回退为浏览器数据表，或返回 SVG EXPORT_LIMIT。图形宽度小于320px时回退，不强行挤压标签。视觉截断时表格仍保留完整原文。地图标签启用时使用声明主题的背景色衬底，不假设所有区域填色都能提供文字对比度。

共享 ECharts 桥安装固定的桑基标签/提示回调，按原文返回源标签，包含 ECharts 模板符号。RenderPlan 仍是 JSON，不接受或执行模型提供的回调/代码。稳定内部 ID 与显示标签分离。

树图 SVG 明确标为**初始折叠概览**，标题/元信息包含完整源层级。它不导出浏览器当前展开状态，也不声称每个后代都可见。浏览器展开不改变数据或 revision，拓扑变化重置展开。选择事件带 eventVersion 0.3，identity 为 node/edge/region 并关联原始行；雷达保持行/行键选择。空桑基或全零流量不会绘制虚构流。不支持缩放状态保留。

## 可信地图资产

`@chartnexus/echarts` 是共享本地 workspace 包，复用既有 ECharts 6.1.0 peer。`createMapAsset(input)` 克隆校验宿主资产、规范化 FeatureCollection，并在 Node/浏览器同步计算相同 SHA-256。宿主字段为 id、revision、coordinateSystem:"WGS84"、license、provenance、geoJSON。每个 feature 的唯一 properties.name 对应文档区域键。仅接受 Polygon/MultiPolygon、有限二维坐标、经度±180/纬度±90、闭合且非退化的环。不做 CRS 转换，不支持 SVG 地图、GeometryCollection 或跨反经线线段。这是有界结构验证，不是完整 GIS 拓扑认证，例如不证明环绝无自交；宿主负责几何正确性及分发权利。

每个宿主资产 JSON ≤5MiB、合计20000坐标点、1000个 feature。共享 ECharts 注册上限为每模块实例8个版本、20MiB规范化几何。注册名包含 id/revision/hash；重复使用相同资产不增容量，同 id/revision 改几何会拒绝。ECharts 没有注销接口，dispose 不释放此容量；耗尽后需新的渲染进程/worker。保留命名空间内的外部覆盖可被检测，不要直接用 `chartnexus:` 名称注册地图。

```ts
import { createMapAsset, mapCatalog } from '@chartnexus/echarts';
import { mountChart } from '@chartnexus/runtime';
import { compileChart } from '@chartnexus/core';
// assetInput 是可信宿主 JSON，不是模型工具参数。
const prepared = createMapAsset(assetInput);
if (!prepared.ok) throw new Error('Invalid host map');
const maps = { [prepared.value.id]: prepared.value };
const plan = compileChart(chartDocument, dataRegistry, mapCatalog(maps));
const mounted = mountChart(container, onSelect, { maps, chatPresentation: {} });
if (mounted.ok) mounted.value.update(chartDocument, dataRegistry);
```

renderSvg、createAgentService、OpenUI/A2UI/COSUI/Marklang 适配器也接收同一 `maps` 宿主选项。core 通过 MapCatalog 只接收元信息/区域键；渲染器重新校验几何/hash，Node worker 接收宿主快照并在已有时限/内存/输出预算下执行相同检查。Agent 的 list_capabilities 只暴露注册元信息/键，不包含坐标。默认 CLI/MCP 进程没有地图；地图 recipe 需要配置宿主。模型参数不能注册资产、选择文件/URL 或绕过 registry。

[项目自制矩形](../../examples/maps/two-regions.json)是 Apache-2.0 合成测试数据，不代表行政边界。[地图 recipe](../../resources/recipes/map-03.json)引用 two-regions@1，manifest 明示宿主要求。本项目未打包或下载真实行政边界。

## 预览、模型资源与证据

运行 `pnpm dev` 后打开 `/expansion.html`，可切换图表/主题/档位/宽度、编辑完整 JSON、查看完整数据和点击图元。已有上游宿主演示也接受 `?m3=radar|tree|sankey|map` 加载同一组自制样例。[雷达](../../resources/recipes/radar-03.json)、[树](../../resources/recipes/tree-03.json)、[桑基](../../resources/recipes/sankey-03.json)和地图 recipe、负例变更、能力限制、诊断和 MCP/RAG 副本由规范资源生成。

见 [SPEC-0035](../../specs/0035-chart-expansion/spec.zh-CN.md)及[验收证据](../../specs/0035-chart-expansion/tasks.zh-CN.md)。本地编译/浏览器/SVG/worker/固定上游 SDK 验证不等于真实模型成功率。M4 有范围的评测、全包干净安装、性能基线和远端 CI 已记录在[M4证据](trial-distribution.md)中；尚未发布 npm，不声称所有协议/模型兼容或全面无障碍认证。

# ChartDocument 0.3 与核心模块边界

0.3 为实验性、仅 intent 的版本，规范 Schema 包含十一种类型专属分支。十一种类型现均可编译：柱状、折线、饼图、散点、组合、漏斗、热力、雷达、树、桑基和地图；地图渲染需要可信宿主资产。见[四类新图契约](chart-expansion-03.md)。结构合法不代表渲染器已经支持。

## 契约与发现

`@chartnexus/schema` 导出 `chartDocument03Schema` 与 `projectChartSchema03(type)`，投影直接来自同一联合的精确分支。普通图表、雷达、树使用 inline/reference 表；桑基使用 `{kind:"graph",nodes:<table>,links:<table>}`；地图使用普通表与可信 `chart.mapRef:{id,revision}` 及显式色域。热力配置缺失会在结构层拒绝；未知字段不被删除，诊断带字段路径。数值范围、引用、键及受支持组合仍由编译验证。

MCP：`get_chart_schema({schemaVersion:"0.3",chartType:"bar"})`；CLI：`pnpm cli schema --schema-version 0.3 --chart-type bar`。Schema 工具默认仍为 0.1。完整 Schema 和已实现能力提供 `/0.3` 资源，十一种类型均进入 `charts`，同时声明各类限制和宿主资产要求。`getChartInputContract({schemaVersion:"0.3",chatPresentation:true})` 返回匹配的完整示例；为兼容已有宿主，默认推荐版本仍是 0.2。

## 显式迁移与身份

`migrateIntentTo03(document, registry?)` 先校验并编译旧 intent，再检查转换后的 0.3 结构。只修改版本，并将 `{theme:{id,version:"1"}}` 转为 `{theme:"light"|"dark"}`。不支持或与图表类型无关的旧字段会被拒绝，不静默丢弃。原生文档保留 0.1，迁移不会自动发生。

可选 `data.keyField` 指向已声明字段，值必须是最长 256 字符的唯一非空字符串。原始顺序和数值不变；`RenderPlan.rowKeys` 随 rowIndices 使用同一排序和选择映射。0.3 事件声明 `eventVersion:"0.3"`，键身份选择包含 `identity:"key"`、rowKey 和当前 rowIndex。未声明键时仍为位置身份；聚合点保留聚合元数据，不伪造行键。非致命提示包含 code/severity/path/message，可选 params。M3 为树、桑基和地图新增 node/edge/region 身份，详见扩充指南。

## 核心职责与评测基础

core 已拆分版本校验、数据表解析、旧版编译、显式变换、时间解析、组合/漏斗/热力处理及展示。分发入口不依赖 DOM、网络或模型 SDK。为确保数值等价，保留旧 0.2 内部已有的图表复用；四种 M3 类型使用独立编译器。

M0 源数据/option/行索引 golden 夹具及已有聚合、时间、单位、失败测试保护拆分。`scripts/evaluation-harness.mjs` 将模型可见提示词与预期数据哈希/渲染值分离，记录首次及最多两次修复结果，并要求模型、设置和编译器来源。合成测试仅验证框架，不是独立模型成绩。实际私有评测集不得进入 resources/retrieval；后续已完成的有范围评测见[M4证据](trial-distribution.md)。

见 [M1 spec](../../specs/0033-contracts-core/spec.zh-CN.md) 与 [任务](../../specs/0033-contracts-core/tasks.zh-CN.md)。

# 聊天宿主质量与支持矩阵

## 展示与访问

聊天展示由宿主显式启用，接受 0.2/0.3 intent。`resolvePresentation(plan,{width,height,target,theme})` 为纯函数；浏览器传当前内容尺寸，SVG 传请求尺寸。不传尺寸时 compileChatChart 保留默认样式，不声称响应式布局。布局为标题、图例、坐标轴和热力色阶预留空间；即使显式请求标签，过密时也可能带提示隐藏，但完整原始值仍可访问。宽度小于 240px、过窄的双轴或绘图区不足时，浏览器明确回退到数据表入口。SVG 装不下必要内容时返回 `EXPORT_LIMIT`，需增大尺寸，不静默删除内容。

共享明暗主题在声明的白色/#111827 背景上检查对比度。透明背景需要宿主背景匹配，不声称适配任意背景。正文目标 4.5:1，必要色板和轴线 3:1。仍禁用动画。原生 HTML button/details 提供键盘访问；源数据表每页 50 行，可翻页访问全部数据，保留 null、单位；渲染值也包含聚合和来源映射。SVG 内含 title 及转义后的完整源数据/渲染表 JSON metadata，宿主可读取；SVG 本身是静态内容。

浏览器控件作为图表容器的同级节点由 runtime 管理，销毁时移除；宿主 CSS 应保证可见、可访问。图表类型/编码/单位兼容时按语义键保留图例选择；删除键清理、新键默认显示，不兼容变化产生 `STATE_RESET`。JavaScript 保留名称使用不可见的渲染别名，访问标签和原始值不变。本阶段不支持缩放状态保留。

## 生命周期与事务

`mountChart` 保留零尺寸立即失败契约。`observeChartMount` 供适配器等待可测量尺寸，只初始化一个 runtime，销毁时取消观察。等待期间保留最后完整合法输入，不将部分或非法输入提交为修订。Marklang 同样等待可测量容器，以内容区宽度在屏幕外暂存全部图表，全部成功后才替换旧节点；失败仅释放暂存。限制为 16 图、1 MiB Markdown、解析输入与 registry 合计 1 MiB；旧新暂时共存限两个已接受文档。

resize 使用上次编译成功的快照，不推进数据或图表修订。回调异常独立报告；渲染失败尝试恢复，`RENDER_RECOVERY_FAILED` 要求重新挂载。Marklang 整体替换文档，因此图例保留和单图修订不跨整体替换保留。

## 流式链路

`createChartStreamBuffer` 已迁到 runtime，保留 A2UI 兼容导出。它缓冲解码后的 JSON，不证明传输完成。`readOllamaStream` 严格增量解码 UTF-8 NDJSON，传输限 4 MiB、文档限 1 MiB，要求 `done:true` 且 `done_reason:"stop"`。截断、缺失终止帧、格式错误、取消或终止后仍有数据均不返回完成操作。

本地 Ollama 页面使用同源代理与 `stream:true`、120 秒期限、取消、生成 epoch 和起始图表修订；手动编辑使旧生成失效。最多两次有界修复，分别记录尝试。一次真实合成 qwen3.5:9b 首次通过，数值 [3,5] 保真，取消验证通过；见 [证据](../../specs/0034-chat-host-quality/ollama-verification.json)。这是冒烟测试，不是模型排名或事实检索服务。此解码器不支持 SSE；其他传输应自行解析帧后使用中立缓冲。

## 固定版本的本地宿主矩阵

| 宿主 | 输入与完成信号 | 聊天/主题/数据表 | 零尺寸 | 有序操作 | 图例保留 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OpenUI react-lang 1.0.2 / React 19.2.4 | JSON 字符串；上游 streaming=false | 支持 | 等待 | 宿主显式启用 | 兼容更新保留 |
| A2UI React 0.9.1 / web_core 0.9.2 | 解析后的 DynamicString；宿主完成操作 | 支持 | 等待 | 宿主显式启用 | 兼容更新保留 |
| COSUI Dynamic UI 1.0.0 / San 3.15.5 | document 对象；宿主完整输入 | 支持 | 等待 | 宿主显式启用 | 兼容更新保留 |
| Marklang 1.0.1 | 命名数据/指令；显式 complete=true | 支持 | 等待事务 | 显式拒绝 | 整体换文档时重置 |

选择、校验错误、有效恢复和销毁由共享 runtime 及固定真实 SDK 夹具验证。Marklang 仍要求可信或已净化 Markdown，本任务不净化任意 HTML。ChartNexus 操作信封不等于上游标准保证。远端宿主、水合、其他 SDK 版本、移动设备认证和全面无障碍认证仍未验证。见 [M2 spec](../../specs/0034-chat-host-quality/spec.zh-CN.md)。

## M3 图表扩充

0.3 在原有七类基础上新增雷达、树、桑基和可信区域地图。见[契约、宿主 MapRegistry、模型资源和预览](chart-expansion-03.md)。浏览器/SVG/worker 与四种固定上游 SDK 路径已有本地证据；M4 模型评测和分发仍是独立工作。固定渲染器标签回调保留原文，仍禁止模型回调。

# Chat presentation profile
[简体中文](../zh-CN/chat-presentation.md)

This host opt-in profile supports 0.2/0.3 intent charts. `compileChatChart(document,settings,registry?)` returns `{plan,adjustments}`; runtime uses `mountChart(container,onSelect,{chatPresentation:settings})`; SVG uses `renderSvg(document,{chatPresentation:settings})`. All four local GenUI profiles support chat settings. MCP validate/compile/render accept chatPresentation; render dimensions use the tool's width/height parameters.

Host theme/background/detail settings take precedence over document preferences. Defaults are light, transparent and standard. Five levels are minimal/simple/standard/detailed/comprehensive. Minimal hides optional titles/grid/labels; simple shows supplied titles; standard adds grid; detailed and comprehensive request more labels, with comprehensive endpoint ticks and axis tooltips. Necessary identity, legend, units and scales remain mandatory. Explicit labels may be suppressed for density when dimensions are provided, with notices and full-data alternatives. No values, nulls, ordering or units are changed for aesthetics.

Core callers may supply width/height/target in settings; runtime and SVG use actual/requested dimensions. Layout fallback, token contrast conditions, keyboard source/rendered tables, SVG metadata, lifecycle and the pinned host matrix are detailed in [chat host quality](chat-host-quality.md). `adjustments` retains the old REQUIRED_LEGEND/LABEL_DENSITY_LIMIT mapping; structured `plan.notices` additionally describes layout fallback and density constraints. Runtime callbacks expose diagnostics, while callers can inspect plans separately.

No automatic host-background detection, arbitrary themes, zoom capability, mobile certification or general accessibility certification is claimed. The local model smoke case and later scoped [evaluation](trial-distribution.md) are separate evidence; model invocation and factual accuracy are host responsibilities, not SDK release gates.

# ChartNexus: entry for models and agents

[简体中文](../zh-CN/model-entry.md)

ChartNexus compiles constrained JSON chart documents to Apache ECharts. For new 0.3 intent generation, discover `chartnexus://capabilities/basic-0.3`, then `chartnexus://schema/chart-document/0.3` and `chartnexus://recipes/manifest/0.1`. Follow the host profile: chat accepts only 0.2/0.3 intent; non-chat also accepts 0.1 intent/native. The inventory `chartnexus://resources/index/0.1` and JSONL corpus `chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1` expose canonical sources and hashes; hashes identify source bytes, not necessarily serialized MCP responses.

Choose `mode: intent`: 0.2 supports bar, line, pie, scatter, combo, funnel and heatmap; 0.3 also supports radar, tree, sankey and host-registered map. Use 0.1 `mode: echarts` only in a non-chat host that enables native input. Never invent fields or capabilities, execute callbacks, fetch URLs, aggregate implicitly, or treat null as zero. Native validation is partial.

Use `validate_chart` for structural and semantic validation. On failure, inspect diagnostic code and path, retrieve a repair example, revise the document, and validate again. `compile_chart` yields an ECharts plan; `render_chart` returns a session-local static SVG resource. Interactivity belongs to a browser host. Data references require a host-supplied registry and revision; never invent accessible datasets.

Start with [bar example](../../resources/recipes/bar.json), [field-error example](../../resources/recipes/unknown-field.json), [diagnostics](../../resources/diagnostics.json), and [GenUI host guide](genui-integrations.md). The [20-task development corpus](../../resources/evaluation/tasks.json) is synthetic and public; it is not a hidden benchmark or real-model result. See [evaluation guide](evaluation-baseline.md) for scoring and limitations.

For ordered browser-host updates, the host captures `baseRevision` before asynchronous generation and supplies a unique `operationId`; do not invent revisions. A `REVISION_CONFLICT` requires obtaining the current revision and resolving the stale work before retrying. A changed payload needs a new operation ID. The optional A2UI, OpenUI and COSUI JSON host profiles use the same ChartNexus operation contract; they are not protocol-native guarantees. See the [GenUI host guide](genui-integrations.md).

An experimental intent-only 0.2 profile is discoverable via `chartnexus://capabilities/basic-0.2` and `chartnexus://schema/chart-document/0.2`. The `get_chart_schema` tool defaults to 0.1; pass `schemaVersion: "0.2"` to retrieve the 0.2 intent schema. Native 0.1 validation is guarded and partial, and the validation result reports `guarded-native-partial`.

For experimental 0.2 bar, line or pie sorting, explicitly set `chart.sort` with `by` (`category` or `value`), `order` (`ascending` or `descending`) and `nulls` (`first` or `last`). Never sort grouped charts by value: the current profile rejects this ambiguous request; aggregation must be resolved upstream. Category order uses UTF-16 code-unit comparison, not locale.

For 0.2 dates use line x `type: temporal`, `temporalKind: date` and valid `YYYY-MM-DD` strings; offset-bearing instants are supported separately, without timezone inference. Declare y units explicitly; percent scale `percent` and `ratio` describe original values and never trigger conversion. Read the 0.2 schema and capabilities before generating.

For 0.2 bar, line and pie, aggregate repeated categories only when the user explicitly requests it: set `chart.aggregate.op` to `sum`, `mean`, or `count`. Count is non-null numeric y count, not total row count; sum/mean ignore null. Do not invent grouping, units, or treat an aggregate as one source row.

For native ECharts input, default validation is partial. When the host requests the small strict subset, read `chartnexus://schema/native-strict-basic/0.1` and call `validate_chart` with `nativeValidation: "strict-basic-0.1"`. Do not claim strict validation of arbitrary ECharts options or silently retry a failure in the partial profile.

For experimental 0.2 intent charts, use `presentation.dataLabels.show` and `presentation.legend.show` with optional legend `position` (`top` or `bottom`). Label content is the ECharts default for that chart type; do not invent formatters or imply automatic percentage conversion.

For 0.2 line time instants use `temporalKind: "instant"` and full ISO strings with `Z` or an explicit numeric offset. Do not omit offsets or invent one. Category sorting compares actual instants; different strings for the same instant are rejected. Display is UTC.

For 0.2 intent, retrieve `chartnexus://recipes/combo/0.2` and `chartnexus://recipes/funnel/0.2` for supported combination and funnel examples. A combo uses a bar and line with distinct fields; shared axes require matching units or both unspecified, while an explicitly requested right axis requires units on both. Never infer conversion rates for funnels or silently convert values.

For 0.2 categorical heatmaps, read `chartnexus://recipes/heatmap/0.2`. Supply distinct x, y and numeric color fields plus explicit min/max from the data or user; do not invent a range, fill missing cells with zero, or implicitly aggregate duplicates.

The host may enable the 0.2 chat profile through `chatPresentation`; a user-requested detail level can be expressed as `presentation.detailLevel` (`minimal`, `simple`, `standard`, `detailed`, `comprehensive`). Host theme, background and level settings take precedence. Without host opt-in the document level does not change rendering. Never remove required legend or alter data for visual simplicity. See [chat profile](chat-presentation.md).

For 0.2 chat charts, read `chartnexus://recipes/chat-bar/0.2` for a valid row-based example and `chartnexus://recipes/funnel/0.2` for a different chart type. Use the user's actual rows and values; examples are not task answers. Theme version is the string `"1"`; omit optional transforms unless requested.

## Responsibilities and focused retrieval

The host decides whether to invoke a chart and owns factual accuracy and data authorization. ChartNexus validates and faithfully renders supported input, reports diagnostics and supplies bounded compatibility; it does not invent facts or guarantee model tool selection. Read [responsibility boundary](product-boundary.md), [chart catalog](chart-catalog.md), and [agent integration and retrieval guide](agent-guide.md). These bilingual documents are present in `chartnexus://resources/retrieval/0.1`; entries with `uri: null` are retrieval records, not separate MCP resources. Use actual host policy and the matching schema version.

## Input contract and semantic notices

Hosts can call `getChartInputContract({ chatPresentation: true, orderedUpdates: false })` from runtime or any JSON adapter. It returns the recommended document schema, accepted profiles, canonical complete example and model description. With ordered updates the example is an illustrative envelope; the host must replace operationId/baseRevision with real session values. A2UI/OpenUI descriptions use this helper; COSUI hosts explicitly add it to their model prompt. Marklang also supports chat settings; ordered envelopes are explicitly rejected.

All-zero nonempty pie/donut values produce no sectors and return `dataState: "no-share"` plus informational `NO_SHARE_DATA`; empty pie returns `dataState: "empty"` without that notice. Preserve the values. Grouped series expose raw group values and display names through `seriesMetadata`; empty labels are disambiguated. These are series identities, not stable row IDs.

## M1/M2 implementation

See [0.3 contracts and migration](contracts-03.md) and [chat host quality/support matrix](chat-host-quality.md) for current version discovery, dimensions, tables, lifecycle, legend retention and real local Ollama streaming evidence. Legacy spec evidence remains historical.

## M3 chart expansion

0.3 now supports radar, tree, Sankey and trusted regional maps in addition to the original seven types. See [contracts, host MapRegistry, resources and preview](chart-expansion-03.md). Browser/SVG/worker and four pinned upstream SDK paths have local evidence; M4 model evaluation and distribution remain separate. Fixed renderer-owned label callbacks preserve text literally; model callbacks remain forbidden.
